text:
Elena (CFO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A re: runway and spend controls. Wanted to capture answers here and surface next steps.
Diego (Eng): thanks  can you clarify current runway in months? heard different numbers in the room.
Elena (CFO): Based on current committed revenue + planned spend our base plan runway is ~16 months. That assumes hiring cadence & current sales funnel deliver as forecasted.
Nina (Product): is that with or without new Dedicated/reserved capacity deals baked in?
Elena (CFO): Conservative plan includes signed Dedicated commitments only. New large reserved deals (> $500k ARR) are in upside scenarios.
Marta (Hiring): so we pause hiring? need to triage offers in our pipeline.
Elena (CFO): Not a hard freeze. New rule: roles must be labelled by hiring committee as "mission-critical" to proceed immediately; others reviewed weekly.
Marta (Hiring): will notify candidates and pause non-critical offers.
Diego (Eng): procurement questions: any change to approval thresholds for infra (GPUs / cloud)?
Asha (FinanceOps): yes  effective immediately: < $25k = budget owner sign-off; $25k-$150k = budget owner + finance manager; > $150k = budget owner + finance director + CFO review.
Diego (Eng): and multi-year committed instances (3yr reserved GPUs) with large upfront cash hit?
Elena (CFO): those are > $150k. We require a 1-page ROI doc and a fallback if utilization lags. Finance will help with vendor negotiation for strategic needs.
Nina (Product): will experiments that raise short-term burn but enable differentiation still be greenlit?
Sam (CEO): short answer: yes, but tightly scoped. We'll fund a small set of high-ROI product bets with 6-8 week measurable milestones.
Diego (Eng): any infra cost-optimization targets for Eng?
CostBot: automated: "Optimize initiative: target 12% infra run-rate reduction over next 3 months via batching, spot, and quantization pilots"
Elena (CFO): That's active. Teams should work with Eng-ML to apply Redwood Optimize recommendations; savings tracked against team budgets.
Asha (FinanceOps): Procurement note: use the Procurement form https://redwood.internal/procure and include vendor, term, expected ARR impact, GL code. Requests missing the form will be returned.
Diego (Eng): is there a fast lane for customer-required on-prem appliances with long lead times?
Elena (CFO): Yes  tag the request "customer critical" and loop in Sales + Solutions + FinanceOps. We'll triage within 48 hrs.
Nina (Product): Dedicated pricing / discounts  are we tightening bands?
Sam (CEO): no broad price increase, but tighter discount bands for new contracts. Sales + Finance will publish updated playbooks this week.
Marta (Hiring): headcount cadence? still quarterly HC forecasting?
Asha (FinanceOps): quarterly remains; we add mid-quarter checkpoints when spend hits 70% of forecast.
Diego (Eng): employee expenses/travel changes? conferences?
Elena (CFO): travel budgets capped per role band for two quarters. Conference travel needs manager + director sign-off; vendor-sponsored travel pre-cleared with FinanceOps.
Diego (Eng): noted.
Nina (Product): will product owners get per-route cost/latency visibility to make tradeoffs?
Sam (CEO): yes  Redwood Console will expose per-route token cost and latency by end of next sprint. Subscribe to dashboards.
Diego (Eng): that will help prioritize optimizations.
Asha (FinanceOps): next steps: 1) Finance posts FAQ in #finance by EOD tomorrow; 2) Procurement form + approval matrix updated; 3) Hiring committee publishes prioritization rubric.
Elena (CFO): drop follow-ups here or DM Asha/ me for sensitive items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Sam (CEO): appreciate the alignment. We're balancing growth + prudence  keep feedback coming.
Diego (Eng): quick ask  can Eng get a point contact in Finance for GPU budgeting?
Asha (FinanceOps): that's me. I'll set weekly office hours for infra & model ops budget syncs. Invite soon.
Diego (Eng): perfect, thanks.
CostBot: automated snapshot: "cash runway 16 months (base), stress scenario 10 months if growth decelerates 30%."
Nina (Product): last q: preserve budget for experiments tied to top OKRs?
Sam (CEO): yes  OKR-aligned bets prioritized; expect crisp milestones + regular check-ins.
Elena (CFO): recap: runway ~16 months base; approval thresholds updated; targeted infra savings; hiring prioritization; procurement form required. FAQ + links will be posted.
Diego (Eng): thanks  helpful.
Marta (Hiring): we'll update candidates.
Asha (FinanceOps): procurement + FAQ updates inbound.
Elena (CFO): closing  if you need accelerated review for a customer or critical hire, @elena or @asha.
